what: A full-width fixed header with a logo and button at both ends gathers into a centered 30rem pill after scrolling just 50px (wide screens only — narrow screens keep full width and only shrink the margins), and the pill background plate comes down from the top as its corners round 0 → 5rem (clip-path inset, 1s cubic-bezier(.65,.05,0,1)). Back at the top it unfolds along the same curve and the background lifts away twice as fast. While shrunk, is-docked is added so the logo and button colors can be repainted

options.at: Scroll position at which it shrinks (px), default 50
options.min: Minimum window width (px) for shrinking to pills, default 992 — below that, width stays 100% and only the margins change
options.back: Background retract speed on return, default 2
options.--fx-pad · --fx-pad-docked: (css variable) top and shrunk margin — changed in the css used at each width step (original 3rem → 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem 2rem)
options.--fx-inset: Distance the backing panel is pulled in from the header row, default .5rem
options.is-docked · fx:dock: Badge shown when shrunk and the event fired on each change (detail.docked)

note: Reads the window scroll (scrollY) — works as is with smooth-scroll libraries that move the window

from.where: shared.css .mj-nav — original initNav: getScrollY() > At 50, maxWidth 100% → 30rem (992 and up), padding 3rem → 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem 2rem, .nav-bg clipPath inset(0 0 100% 0 round 0) → inset(0 0 0 0 round 5rem) 1s navEase, reverse timeScale 2
